All foods should be very fresh or properly frozen. Meat
products should not be refrigerated more than three to
four days. Refrigerated cheeses should be eaten within two 
to three weeks. Combination foods like cheese crackers,
submarine sandwiches, and stir-fried dishes containing soy
sauce should be avoided. Pizza, lasagna, and other cheese-
containing dishes may be eaten only if made with “allowed”
cheeses and toppings.
